svg.text: 1U rack chassis, single board, host-attached. Generated from hw/board.yaml by hw/kicad_gen.py. Blue: ring ribbons on In2.Cu; pink: core-rail islands on In8.Cu. Rear of the chassis at the bottom.

Memory, PCIe and management nets are unrouted. Longest lane per hop: FPGA -> A0 39 mm; A0 -> A1 38 mm; A1 -> A2 38 mm; A2 -> A3 38 mm; A3 -> A4 38 mm; A4 -> A5 38 mm; A5 -> A6 38 mm; A6 -> A7 38 mm; A7 -> H0 38 mm; H0 -> H1 38 mm; H1 -> FPGA 39 mm
